name: The boxes beneath the water

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: The recovered manacles show that the cargo included a human prisoner.
description: Among the ship’s broken timbers, salvaged strongboxes bring coins, jewelry and letters to the surface. Most are only remnants of a scattered cargo. Renn finds something different among them: enchanted iron manacles. Their presence changes the question. The precious cargo was not simply a cache of valuables; someone had been bound aboard the ship. The evidence points to a human prisoner, but gives no new identity beyond the earlier Classic disclosure.
